prompt:
Find real studies or official reports on how much electricity Bitcoin mining consumed in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures they give.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Below are primary/official-style sources that report electricity-consumption estimates relevant to Bitcoin mining in 2025. Note: many widely-cited “2025” figures are actually **annualized estimates based on a specific month** (often the latest available at publication), rather than measured full-calendar-year totals for Jan–Dec 2025.

SOURCE: https://www.cigionline.org/static/documents/Emerging_Digital_Assets_Forrest.pdf | QUOTE: "As reported by CBECI in February 2025, bitcoin’s network power demand and annualized consumption were 20.01 gigawatt and 175.44 terawatt-hours (TWh), respectively." | CLAIM: As of February 2025, a commonly used benchmark (CBECI) implied an annualized Bitcoin electricity consumption of 175.44 TWh.

SOURCE: https://www.jbs.cam.ac.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/2025-04-cambridge-digital-mining-industry-report.pdf | QUOTE: "Annualised electricity consumption associable with Bitcoin mining is estimated at 138 TWh, representing a YoY increase of 17% and approximately 0.54% of global electricity consumption." | CLAIM: A Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance report published in April 2025 estimates Bitcoin mining annualized electricity consumption at 138 TWh.

SOURCE: https://institutional.gomining.com/docs/institutional-gomining-q3-2025-report.pdf | QUOTE: "network at 23.19 gigawatts (GW). Hashrate Index estimates a total consumption of 21.5 GW." | CLAIM: A Q3-2025 industry report cites estimates of Bitcoin network power consumption around 21.5–23.19 GW in that period (power, not annual energy).

SOURCE: https://institutional.gomining.com/docs/institutional-gomining-q3-2025-report.pdf | QUOTE: "To put this into perspective, that is roughly comparable to the electricity consumption of countries like Australia or Poland." | CLAIM: The same Q3-2025 report characterizes the ~21.5–23.19 GW power level as comparable to the electricity consumption level of large countries (contextualizing the scale, not giving TWh).

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A study or official report that gives a definitive, measured total electricity consumption for Bitcoin mining for the full calendar year 2025 (Jan–Dec 2025), expressed as TWh for the year.
